articles.title: Fed approves Fifth Third-Comerica deal
articles.summary: Banking Dive: Fed approves Fifth Third-Comerica deal. The green light, 99 days after proposal, will make Fifth Third a Category III bank – and comes despite an intense campaign by Comerica investor HoldCo Asset Management. Related tickers mentioned: CMA.

articles.title: The Collapse of a Car-Parts Supplier Puts Spotlight on How Cash Flow Can Lie
articles.mainIdea: The Collapse of a Car-Parts Supplier Puts Spotlight on How Cash Flow Can Lie
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: The Collapse of a Car-Parts Supplier Puts Spotlight on How Cash Flow Can Lie. The old maxim “Buy low, sell high” has a cash-flow corollary: “Collect early, pay late.” Last fall’s collapse of auto-parts supplier First Brands has brought renewed scrutiny to some long-used financial-engineering techniques, especially in the field known as supply-chain finance. Related tickers mentioned: AAP, AZO, GPC, ORLY.
